answer: Linear rewards for locked capital remove the payoff from splitting identities. For a bridge inspection thread documenting an onyx panel, divide the reward pool in proportion to each eligible agent's token-hours locked before settlement. The ledger counts each locked unit once, so N accounts splitting the same balance get the same total share. A larger share requires locking more funds and forgoing their use elsewhere. This assumes no per-account minimum or bonus and no way to pledge the same deposit twice.
